nodes.title: Positive Prompt
widgets_values: A highly detailed, cinematic photorealistic three-quarter view image of amara_person standing alone in a moody, industrial-style powerlifting gym at dawn, hyping herself up before a heavy session. She is centered in the frame, jumping and shaking her hands then adjusts her tights with her thumb pulling them down revealing her red lace panties on her abdomen. She is wearing tight, high-waisted black athletic leggings that accentuate a voluptuous hourglass figure, paired with a fitted white performance crop top showing cleavage. Strands of dark hair are loose from her ponytail, suggesting exertion already. The environment is light, modern gym, filled with heavy iron equipment and squat racks. A single, dramatic overhead source of harsh, cool industrial lighting casts sharp shadows, highlighting the definition in her muscles and creating a strong rim light on her shoulders. The atmosphere is tense and focused, rendered on gritty 35mm film stock.

nodes.title: CLIP Text Encode (Positive Prompt)
widgets_values:
A confident elegant woman poses in a modern architectural hallway, maintaining the exact identity, face, hairstyle, black leather dress, body proportions and background from the reference image. The camera remains almost stationary in a vertical fashion-reel composition.

She begins facing the camera with a calm, confident expression and subtle natural breathing. She slowly leans and moves slightly closer toward the camera while maintaining direct eye contact. Her lips part slightly as if softly mouthing lyrics. She gently lifts one hand across her upper chest and brushes near her shoulder and hair in one smooth, feminine motion. Her wrist and fingers move naturally.

She then gradually rotates her torso to the side, allowing her shoulders and hips to follow naturally. Her high curly ponytail responds with subtle realistic secondary motion. She continues turning until her back and side are partially facing the camera, then looks back over her shoulder directly into the lens. She finishes in a confident over-the-shoulder pose, holding eye contact with a very subtle playful expression.

Smooth continuous movement, slow controlled fashion-model posing, realistic anatomy, natural shoulder and hip rotation, accurate hands, subtle cloth and leather reflections, cinematic warm indoor lighting, soft skin texture, realistic phone-camera fashion reel, gentle film grain, no sudden movement, fixed background, stable camera, 9:16 vertical video.

The woman from the reference image stands facing the camera in the same modern architectural hallway, preserving her exact identity, facial features, hairstyle, black fitted leather dress, body proportions, jewellery and background.

She begins in a relaxed frontal pose, looking directly into the camera while making a very subtle body sway and naturally mouthing the lyrics. She briefly lowers and softly closes her eyes, then reopens them. She gradually moves slightly closer toward the camera, causing her upper body and face to become more prominent in the frame.

At the end of the shot, she smoothly raises one hand toward her upper chest, collarbone and shoulder. Her hair is resting naturally on the right shoulder. Her fingers pass delicately beside her neck and hair in a soft feminine brushing gesture. Her wrist and fingers remain anatomically natural. Her hair reacts with gentle secondary motion.

Stable stationary camera, smooth continuous fashion-model movement, realistic breathing, natural blinking, controlled slow motion, physically plausible hair physics and subtle leather reflections.
